experiment.topic: BTC-USD hourly VWAP reversion under liquidity friction and order flow imbalance
experiment.hypothesis: BTC-USD hourly VWAP deviations exceeding 4% of the VWAP from its mean are statistically likely to revert within the next 20 hours due to liquidity friction and order flow imbalance, despite apparent intraday momentum signals.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If, over a 20-hour lookback, the BTC-USD hourly VWAP reversion signal (defined as price moving beyond 4% of the VWAP from its mean) fails to produce a statistically significant mean reversion (p-value > 0.05 in a t-test of price return vs. VWAP deviation), then the hypothesis is falsified.
